attendu.comment: Baccalaureat: 51 entries of the official program directory (academic-programs sitemap, 68 entries) that are degrees, majors or BET streams/specialisations, after setting aside 1 certificate, 3 diplomas, 5 post-bacc diplomas and 8 graduate programs; unit = directory entry (degrees and majors are both listed as programs). Each subject page's 'Program Types' labels were read to classify. BET stream rows use the calendar's full names (directory labels: Chemical, Electronics & Controls, Environmental Studies, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Petroleum). Certificat: the directory lists only 1 certificate, so the 19 certificates named in the 2025-2026 calendar (incl. 3 retired/discontinued) were used; the directory's Mi'kmaw Cultural Tourism certificate is one of them.
